text: Day one. You're a waiter on a cruise ship. Three thousand passengers. Seven days at sea.
Then every phone on board buzzes at once. Stay in your cabins.
And the captain stops talking... mid-sentence.
On Deck Five, people are walking strangely. Too slowly. And they're coming this way.
Rule number one. Don't run to the lifeboats. Everyone else will.
You go down. To the one place nobody thinks about. The galley.
Food for three weeks. Water for nine days. And one steel door.
Rule number two. Be quiet. They follow sound.
You push a cart against the door... and you wait.
Day twelve. The ship is silent. Then, deep below you... the engines start again.
Someone else is alive on this ship.
